# Approval batch error reporting

Base: shipped 4662dbec481c4bb164c7722d2d6f26e15eeddd93, deployment dpl_BEhZHrNJWZFJLa8oTpM6JVnqEWAi. User screenshot shows an approval-only five-node batch, four ready, no submissions, Node 1 deliberately deferred, and the generic deferral as the headline. The user also supplied RPC HTTP200/204 rows, which do not establish JSON-RPC success. The first actual error/unknown node message has been requested. Do not infer insufficient gas or a backend outage from these observations.

R1 scope: correct presentation of batch failure evidence in NodeTrading and its tests. Root owns preflight, integration and release; feature_builder owns the bounded implementation; verification_engineer reproduces independently; fresh Astra High review required. Production signing, gas reserves, batch selection/execution, authorizations, slippage and retries are unchanged. Standing user authorization includes tested Hoodlabs fixes and shipping. No funded trades, owner secrets or unrelated deployments.

Acceptance: in a mixed approval-only batch, an early deliberately deferred node must not mask the first actual error or unknown outcome on a later node. The banner identifies the responsible node and its actual reason. Deliberate deferred sales are described separately from failed approvals and skipped actions. Pending/confirmed/failed/unknown receipts and partial outcomes remain visible after refresh. Never report approvals confirmed when none submitted, never suggest resubmission of unknown work, and do not automatically advance approvals into sales. Preserve existing exact-hash history and account/session boundaries. Use actual-component deterministic browser coverage including all-five-unsent, partly submitted, unknown and confirmed-approval cases.

Required gates: failing reproduction before fix, focused browser regression, typecheck, relevant existing tests, production build/scanner/audit, independent verification and fresh review of final source, exact-head hosted CI and live release identity/public checks. Existing 4662dbe evidence is a baseline, not proof of new UI behavior. Do not claim the user's underlying approval failure fixed until actual error evidence supports it.
